item.title: Greek Parliament pushes through migration law amid rights…
item.description: Greece’s Parliament has approved new “legal migration” legislation, carried solely by the governing New Democracy, with every opposition party voting against the bill in principle. The law establishes that migrants who entered the country irregularly are permanently excluded from legalisation.
